committedBaselineFindings.note: git HEAD (pre-session) had real, live mutation/execution capability in all three legacy scripts below. The working tree already had partial hardening applied earlier this session before this pass started; this pass finished it structurally.

scripts_atlas_apply_error_fixes_mjs.realBugFound: restartEmbeddingService() ran `docker restart legal-ai-ollama` via execSync UNCONDITIONALLY, before isDryRun was checked -- dry-run could mutate live service state. In --apply mode it additionally ran a real `UPDATE error_logs ... RETURNING` via markErrorsAsResolved().
scripts_atlas_apply_error_fixes_mjs.secondBugFound: dry-run mode incremented totalFixed += count for merely-eligible candidates and reported that number as 'Total Fixed' -- a would-be repair was represented as an actual one.

scripts_atlas_agentic_toolgan_execute_mj.realBugFound: accepted an arbitrary --cmd argument and called execSync(command, {cwd: ROOT, ...}) in apply mode; the simulate-only (dry-run) branch fabricated result:'success' and proof.smoke:'PASS' even though nothing was run.

scripts_atlas_agentic_toolgan_replay_mjs.realBugFound: --test mode auto-exited 0 with no validation ('Automatically passing'). Ordinary replay mode re-executed every recorded historical command via execSync and printed 'REPLAY SUCCESS: Deterministic execution verified!' if all exited 0 -- treating command re-execution as proof.

scripts_atlas_apply_error_fixes_mjs: Removed executeCommand()/execSync, restartEmbeddingService(), and markErrorsAsResolved() (the UPDATE error_logs call) entirely -- not gated, removed.
--apply now exits 2 immediately with AGENTIC_ERROR_FIX_APPLY_BLOCKED_GOVERNED_EXECUTOR_REQUIRED before Postgres is touched at all.

Dry-run (the only remaining mode) never reports a nonzero totalFixed; it is hardcoded to 0. Eligible-but-unactioned candidates are reported separately as wouldAffectCount/unfixableCount, diagnostic-only, never folded into a fixed total. repairProof is always false.
Replaced the nonstandard fetch({timeout}) option with a real AbortSignal.timeout(5000).
scripts_atlas_agentic_toolgan_execute_mj: No execSync/execFile/spawn call exists in this file (already removed by an earlier pass this session; this pass verified it live via a structural grep, not assumed).

The simulate-only branch (its only remaining branch) no longer writes result:'success'/proof.smoke:'PASS'. It now writes result:null and proof.smoke:'NOT_EXECUTED' -- a simulated plan can no longer be indistinguishable from a really-executed one.
--apply still exits 2 with TOOLGAN_APPLY_REQUIRES_GOVERNED_MUTATION_RECEIPT as defense-in-depth, but the deeper fix is that even the default (no-flag) path can no longer fabricate a success verdict.
scripts_atlas_agentic_toolgan_replay_mjs: No execSync/execFile/spawn call exists in this file (already removed by an earlier pass this session; verified live).

--test no longer auto-passes: it still requires a real --trace_id resolving to a real timeline event, and does not skip the unconditional process.exit(2) refusal at the end. Live-verified: `--test` alone exits 1 (missing trace_id); `--test --trace_id=doesnotexist-1234` exits 1 (event not found); a --test run against a real trace_id would still hit the same terminal exit(2) as non-test mode.
scripts_atlas_agentic_toolgan_log_outcom: NEW fix this pass, not previously flagged in the task text: this file reads the plan execute.mjs just fabricated and, before this fix, would have unconditionally appended any result to successes.ndjson/failures.ndjson/do-not-repeat.ndjson based on a naive `result === 'success' ? success : failure` branch -- meaning execute.mjs's now-corrected result:null would have fallen into the ELSE branch and been permanently logged as a FALSE FAILURE, which is arguably worse than the original false-success bug for downstream do-not-repeat suppression logic.

Fixed by adding an explicit early check: `proof.smoke === 'NOT_EXECUTED' || result == null` writes only to timeline.ndjson (activity log, not a verdict store) and refuses (exit 2, AGENTIC_TOOLGAN_OUTCOME_NOT_LOGGED_NO_REAL_EXECUTION_PROOF) to touch the three verdict ledgers. Live-verified end to end: ran execute.mjs (produced result:null/NOT_EXECUTED), then log-outcome.mjs against that exact plan -- timeline.ndjson gained an entry, successes.ndjson/failures.ndjson/do-not-repeat.ndjson line counts were unchanged (3/1/5 respectively, before and after).
